import re

def parse(lines):
    skip = []
    used = []
    recs = []
    ppos, lpos = 35, 44
    cur = None
    hdr_re = re.compile(r'^Interface\s+Admin\s+Link\s+Proto\s+Local\s+Remote')
    row_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<iface>\S+)\s+(?P<admin>up|down)\s+(?P<link>up|down)\b')

    def tail(line, cur):
        proto = ''
        local = ''
        remote = ''
        start = min(ppos, len(line))
        toks = [(m.start(), m.group(0)) for m in re.finditer(r'\S+', line[start:])]
        toks = [(p + start, t) for p, t in toks]
        if toks and toks[0][0] < lpos - 1:
            proto = toks[0][1]
            toks = toks[1:]
        vals = [t for p, t in toks if t != '-->']
        if vals:
            local = vals[0]
        if len(vals) > 1:
            remote = vals[1]
        return proto, local, remote

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        s = line.strip()
        if hdr_re.match(line):
            p = line.find('Proto')
            l = line.find('Local')
            if p > 0 and l > p:
                ppos, lpos = p, l
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\S+@\S+[>#%]', s) or re.match(r'^\{.*\}$', s):
            skip.append(i)
            cur = None
            continue
        m = row_re.match(line)
        if m:
            proto, local, remote = tail(line, None)
            cur = {'Interface': m.group('iface'), 'Admin': m.group('admin'), 'Link': m.group('link'), 'Proto': proto}
            recs.append({'Interface': cur['Interface'], 'Admin': cur['Admin'], 'Link': cur['Link'], 'Proto': proto, 'Local': local, 'Remote': remote})
            used.append(i)
            continue
        if line[:1].isspace() and cur is not None:
            proto, local, remote = tail(line, cur)
            if proto:
                cur['Proto'] = proto
            else:
                proto = cur['Proto']
            recs.append({'Interface': cur['Interface'], 'Admin': cur['Admin'], 'Link': cur['Link'], 'Proto': proto, 'Local': local, 'Remote': remote})
            used.append(i)
            continue
    return {'blocks': [{'name': 'interfaces', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': recs}], 'skip': skip}
